constraints: When subclassing an MPM base material for custom behavior, override the constitutive update method such as update_F_S_Jp with a kernel-compatible implementation; do not rely on the base implementation, which raises NotImplementedError and cannot be compiled inside Taichi kernels.
error_examples: A custom material inherited gs.materials.MPM.Base but did not implement update_F_S_Jp, leading to an Unsupported node "Raise" error during kernel compilation.

constraints: For ordinary MPM elastic bodies, instantiate a concrete material class such as gs.materials.MPM.Elastic instead of an abstract or base MPM material class.
error_examples: Instantiating gs.materials.MPM.Material directly caused an Unsupported node "Raise" error because the abstract material did not implement the required physics update methods.

constraints: Do not pass linear_damping or angular_damping to gs.materials.Rigid; rigid material options describe properties such as density, friction, restitution, and coupling behavior, while dynamic damping should be configured on the entity, link, or solver-level settings when supported.
error_examples: gs.materials.Rigid(..., linear_damping=...) was used to configure body damping, but the material constructor does not accept that parameter.

constraints: Configure interactive viewer resolution with ViewerOptions(res=(width, height)); do not use renderer-specific options such as BatchRenderer(resolution=...) for viewer window resolution.
error_examples: A task attempted to set viewer resolution via gs.options.renderers.BatchRenderer(resolution=(1920, 1200)) instead of gs.options.ViewerOptions(res=(1920, 1200)).

constraints: Use pos to place a Box morph; do not use center as a constructor argument.
error_examples: gs.morphs.Box(center=...) was used, but the Box morph constructor expects position-style placement through pos.

constraints: Use file to provide a mesh path to gs.morphs.Mesh; do not use path as a constructor argument.
error_examples: gs.morphs.Mesh(path=...) was used, but the Mesh morph expects file=... for the mesh filename.

constraints: Use file to provide mesh-set input to gs.morphs.MeshSet; do not use path as a constructor argument.
error_examples: gs.morphs.MeshSet(path=...) was used, but MeshSet expects file=... for the mesh-set input.

constraints: Create planes through the morph namespace, for example gs.morphs.Plane(); do not use gs.shapes.Plane(), because Genesis geometric primitives are exposed as morphs rather than shapes.
error_examples: gs.shapes.Plane() failed because the genesis module does not expose a shapes namespace for primitives.

constraints: Do not configure interactive viewer resolution with BatchRenderer(resolution=...); use ViewerOptions(res=...) for viewer resolution instead.
error_examples: gs.options.renderers.BatchRenderer(resolution=(1920, 1200)) was used for viewer resolution, but BatchRenderer does not accept that resolution argument.

run_meta.note: Conservative v0 constraints derived from existing reviewed error memories. No benchmark run, merge, or re-ingest has been performed yet.
